step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture represents a multi-region high-performance machine learning training system designed by TRI-AD (Toyota Research Institute - Advanced Development). The board is visually divided into Region 1 and Region 2. In Region 1, high-performance compute is represented by an EC2 Placement Group (utilizing P3 instances) coupled with FSx for Lustre (FSX) for fast data access. S3 replication is configured between Amazon S3 in Region 1 and Region 2. A CloudFormation template can spin up a secondary cluster (EC2) in Region 2 when compute resources in Region 1 are depleted. Service Catalog is used for sharing templates and infrastructure models with sister companies. Visual connections show FSx feeding EC2, S3 replicating across regions, and CloudFormation deploying the cluster in Region 2.
